note: Tidal stream along the route from SalishSeaCast (UBC, src 2) and WebTide NE Pacific (DFO, src 1), resolved onto the route heading, + = with you, knots. Each sample (every step_nm along the chain): [src, mean, A1, g1, A2, g2, ...] in the order of const; [0] = no model. along(t) = mean + sum f*A*cos(ph0 + w*hours since t0 - g). Built by scripts/build_stream_field.py. For planning, not navigation. Remapped onto the current route from the stream grid by scripts/remap_stream_field.py.
